description.narrative: On 13 June 2023, The EBRD invested EUR 45 million in the inaugural EUR 500 million Green Covered Bond issued by UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia a.s. ("UCBCS") and first of its kind in the Czech Republic. The Bond has a maturity of 5 years and it is listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. On 18 September 2024, the EBRD invested EUR 35 million in the second EUR 500 million Covered Bond issued by UCBCS under the Project. The Bond has a maturity of 4.5 years, and it is listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. On 03 September 2025, the EBRD invested EUR 12.5 million in the third EUR 500 million Covered Bond issued by UCBCS under the Project. The Bond has a maturity of 4.5 years, and it is listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. The Project delivers a strong contribution to the Bank's green agenda in the Czech Republic and Slovakia by expanding green lending in both countries. This is achieved through support for the first-ever Green Covered Bond issued out of the Czech Republic in June 2023, as well as the 2024 investment and the current investment, both of which involve UCBCS committing to allocate an amount equal to 170% of the EBRD proceeds to financing green projects in line with the EBRD's Green Economy Transition (GET) requirements. Furthermore, the Project contributes to the resilience and enhanced funding profile of UCBCS, one of the systemic banks in the country.
